name: Dancing In Church
overview: Scripture presents dancing in the context of worship and celebration within God's people, as seen when Miriam led the women in dance with timbrels after deliverance, and Jephthah's daughter greeted him with dances and musical instruments. The Psalms encourage praising the Lord through dance and music in His sanctuary, highlighting joy and thanksgiving as expressions of heartfelt worship. Dancing is portrayed as a response to God's salvation and goodness, transforming mourning into gladness and serving as a fitting accompaniment to vocal and instrumental praise.
